newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 6.121 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 6.121 mln gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended March 15 was 6,121,429 gallons compared with 5,215,248 gallons last week.
Imports were 743,141 gallons compared with 424,913 gallons the previous week. There were 38,939 domestic receipts for this week compared with none the previous week.
Retail movement was 1,101,801 gallons, while bulk movement was 4,476,901 gallons.
Current season cumulative movement was 81,334,864 gallons.
The final total pack for the season is 158,920,146 gallons.
